# PH's AIxArchviz FLUX2.k9b Series: IMAGE EDIT *A multipurpose Workflow that lets you edit images without pixel degradation.* Showcase: [Youtube Video Walkthrough](https://youtu.be/6aXJqRhjXo0) ___ ## Support, feedback, suggestions and improvements highly appreciated ❤️ - comfycloud: [ComfyCloud](https://cloud.comfy.org/?via=ph01) (affiliate link, i may earn a commission) - Web: [paulhansen.de](https://www.paulhansen.de) - Instagram: [paulhansen.design](https://www.instagram.com/paulhansen.design/) - LinkedIn: [Paul Hansen](https://www.linked.com/in/ph3d) - Discord: [PH's AIxArchviz Discord](https://discord.gg/3UW5ZaWpWq) - Ko-Fi: [ko-fi/paulhansen](https://www.ko-fi.com/paulhansen) ___ ## HOW TO USE THIS WORKFLOW Make sure all models used in this workflow are available on your device (including correct folder placement). Load any image in the LOAD IMAGE (image 1) node as a starting point for your edits, load any REFERENCE IMAGE (image 2) for using its content during editing. Reffer to the images in your prompt, e.g. "add the flamingo from image 2 to stand on the summer meadow in image 1 bright sunlight". Either use an RGB IMAGE, Maske Editor or a Prompt in "AUTOMASK BY PROMPT" to create your mask for the editing. For smoother results increase SOFTEN MASK value. **Note that SEPERATE MASK COMPONENTS works best with values below 5 for SOFTEN MASK feature.** Use Auto-enhance, -remove or -outpaint according to your needs. ___ ### Custom Nodes: - [ComfyUI-KJNodes by Kijai](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes) - [ComfyUI_essentials by Matteo](https://github.com/cubiq/ComfyUI_essentials) - [masquerade modes by BadCafeCode](https://github.com/BadCafeCode/masquerade-nodes-comfyui) - [LanPaint by scraed](https://github.com/scraed/LanPaint) - [Inpaint Crop & Stitch by lquesada](https://github.com/lquesada/ComfyUI-Inpaint-CropAndStitch) *For installation, use the ComfyUI-Manager or find the terminal commands in the respective repository.*
EXAMPLE: `git clone https://github.com/scraed/LanPaint` executed in `/ComfyUI/custom_nodes/` ### Model Downloads for Local Inference **checkpoints** - [sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/sam3.1/blob/main/checkpoints/sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors) **diffusion_models** - [flux-2-klein-9b.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9B/blob/main/flux-2-klein-9b.safetensors) *NOTE: this is a **Gated** model, accept TOS on the huggingface repo to access!* **text_encoders** - [qwen_3_8b.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/vae-text-encorder-for-flux-klein-9b/blob/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_3_8b.safetensors) **loras** - [ph_f2k9b_localforestlab_v1.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/paulhax/flux2-klein-9b-localforestlab/resolve/main/ph_f2k9b_localforestlab_v1.safetensors) **vae** - [flux2-vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/blob/main/split_files/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors) **upscale_models** - [RealESRGAN_x2.pth](hhttps://huggingface.co/ai-forever/Real-ESRGAN/resolve/main/RealESRGAN_x2.pth) Model Storage Location ``` 📂 ComfyUI/ ├── 📂 models/ │ ├── 📂 checkpoints/ │ │ └── sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors │ ├── 📂 duffusion_models/ │ │ └── flux-2-klein-9b.safetensors │ ├── 📂 text_encoders/ │ │ └── qwen_3_8b.safetensors │ ├── 📂 loras/ │ │ └── ph_f29kb_foliage_v1.safetensors │ ├── 📂 vae/ │ │ └── flux2-vae.safetensors │ └── 📂 upscale_models/ │ │ └── RealESRGAN_x2.pth ```
